question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A medical condition in which somebody partly or completely loses their memory
solution:
The correct answer is '**Amnesia**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Amnesia**'.
 
• It means 'the loss of memories, such as facts, information and experiences (यादों की हानि, जैसे तथ्य, सूचना और अनुभव)'.
 
 
• *Example: She'd been terrified since being told she had **amnesia**, but she'd stayed strong*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Amnesia.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Asphyxia**: the state of being unable to breathe, which causes somebody to die or to become unconscious. (साँस न ले पाने की स्थिति, जो बेहोशी या मृत्‍यु का कारण बन सकती है; श्‍वासरोध)
 
• **Anaemia**: a medical condition in which there are not enough red cells in the blood. (रक्त में लाल कणों की कमी; रक्ताल्‍पता, ख़ून की कमी, अरक्तता)
 
• **Alopecia**: the partial or complete absence of hair from areas of the body where it normally grows; baldness. (शरीर के उन क्षेत्रों से बालों की आंशिक या पूर्ण अनुपस्थिति जहां यह सामान्य रूप से बढ़ता है; गंजापन)
